observations: Photo shows a front-load washer-dryer (2-in-1) with a large circular door and control panel on top.
Brand name visible on the panel: 'LG' (photo 0).
Seller text says 'Samsung' and 'scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair' (seller words, not verifiable from photo).
No power-on screen/indicator is shown; machine condition (damage/leaks) is not clearly documented beyond general wear.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'LG' logo and 'DirectDrive 6/3kg' panel text, not Samsung.
Photo 0 does not show clear scrap indicators (e.g., missing parts, severe structural damage).
Photo 0 shows no power-on test, error code, or demonstration of non-function.

risks.risk: Wrong brand/model stated by seller (Samsung vs LG), which affects parts availability and repair cost.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the machine's rating plate/model number sticker (usually on the door frame or back) showing brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-working LG washer-dryer with unknown exact model (worst-case parts/repair uncertainty).

risks.risk: Non-working status may be unconfirmed; could be minor issue or could be dead (power board, motor, heater, control).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: plug in, press power, select a short wash, and show any error code/LEDs (even if it fails).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (worst case) until a test/error code is shown.

risks.risk: Washer-dryer has two systems (wash + dry); dry heater/thermostat may be faulty even if wash works.
risks.proof: Ask for a test showing wash cycle completion and a separate dry cycle attempt (or at least heater activation) with any error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional (treat as both wash and dry needing repair).

risks.risk: Potential water leaks, drum seal issues, or damaged door/latch not visible clearly.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the door seal/gasket and the bottom area for leaks, plus a photo of the drain hose connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require seal/hoses repair (worst-case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/model number sticker (brand + exact model).
Power-on video showing LEDs/error codes when attempting a short wash.
Video showing whether wash cycle starts and drains (even if it stops).
Close-up photos of door gasket/seal and any visible damage around the door/latch.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows an LG washer-dryer (DirectDrive 6/3kg), contradicting the seller’s Samsung claim, and the 'doesn’t work' status is not proven by any power-on/error-code evidence. Missing model number and non-working proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
